current.text: He was traded from Charlotte to Chicago.
He is a bench guard in Chicago. Tre Jones is the sixth man, and Isaac Okoro and Jalen Smith come ahead of Hield in the bench order.
Not worth drafting. Even if he starts, he is not an automatic add. He is only a three-point streamer.
His contract is guaranteed. It was used mostly as matching salary.
Chicago is expected to be a bad team this season.

durable.text: He is no longer an elite three-point shooter, and he gives little outside of threes.
His three-point attempt rate stays steady (67 and 65 percent of his shots). His three-point percentage fell from 39 to 37 to 35 over three seasons.

note: Hield is not a draft target in our 12-team, 144-player auction. Yahoo ranks him 305 and ESPN 271, both value him at 0 USD, and he was not drafted in our league last season. Projections put him near 1.5 threes and about 7 points in a bench role, with no category above the pool except a low turnover count. Leave him on waivers. Check early in the season whether a Chicago guard injury or a buyout gives him minutes, and only then use him as a short-term three-point streamer.
